title: Commercial flat roofing
shortDesc: Flat roofs on apartment communities, retail, and other commercial buildings. You get a written bid after someone is on the roof.
fullDesc: A flat roof over a complex, a retail building, or a row of apartment buildings is a different job than a house. Faber Roof’s commercial flat roofing work is aimed at property managers and building owners who need a crew that can stay on a large roof. Call {{phone}} with the address. Someone looks at the flat roof, then you get a written scope and a bid.
highlights: Commercial flat roofing for complexes and multi-building sites
Apartment and condo communities, including deferred maintenance
Up to 20 workers on a roof when the job needs it
Thousands of squares a week, not a 4- or 5-person crew
10-year labor and material warranty on most roofs
Mulehide-certified installer
heading: Flat roofs property managers have put off
body: A property management company with about 1,000 units across 40 or 50 buildings often waits until the roofs cannot wait any longer. That is the work this page is for. You send the list. We look, then we bid the flat roof work.

sections.heading: Flat roofs property managers have put off
sections.body: Large complexes and apartment or condo communities are the main focus. A property manager who has been patching for years can send the buildings that need service. We look at the flat roof, write the scope, and put a crew on it that can finish the volume. A typical 4- or 5-person crew walks away from that kind of job. We can put up to 20 workers on a roof and turn thousands of squares a week.

sections.heading: Commercial flat roofing and TPO
sections.body: Commercial flat roofing here includes a TPO roof when that membrane is the right system for the building. TPO is the flat-roof system a lot of commercial owners ask for by name. The estimate says whether a TPO roof fits, after someone has been up there. Metal roofing is a separate option when the building should not take another flat or shingle roof, and there is less competition for that work too.

sections.heading: How the roof goes on
sections.body: We do not cut corners. We do it the right way every time. Faber Roof is a Mulehide-certified installer. Mulehide is the Firestone membrane brand. That certification is what lets us offer a 10-year labor and material warranty on most roofs we service, not a material-only warranty.

sections.heading: Ask for a bid
sections.body: Property managers and commercial owners: call {{phone}} or request an estimate and say it is a large project. Houses are still taken, on a separate residential path. The office is on Haggerty Road in Farmington Hills, and the crew drives across Metro Detroit, including Detroit.

faq.q: Do you bid commercial flat roofs?
faq.a: Yes. Commercial flat roofing for complexes, apartment and condo communities, and other commercial buildings. Call {{phone}} and ask for a bid.

moreFaqs.q: Can you handle a property with dozens of buildings?
moreFaqs.a: That is the work we want. A property manager with about 1,000 units across 40 or 50 buildings can send the roofs that have been put off. We can put up to 20 workers on a roof.

moreFaqs.q: Is a flat roof the same as a TPO roof?
moreFaqs.a: Flat roof is the general term. A TPO roof is one membrane system used on commercial flat roofing. The estimate names the system after the look. See the TPO roofing page for that system.

moreFaqs.q: What warranty is on the roof?
moreFaqs.a: A 10-year labor and material warranty on most roofs we service. We are a Mulehide-certified installer. Mulehide is the Firestone membrane brand.

title: TPO roofing
shortDesc: A TPO roof for commercial buildings and flat roofs. Written scope after the look, for property managers and owners.
fullDesc: There are not many crews chasing TPO roof work. Faber Roof installs a TPO roof as part of commercial flat roofing: membrane on a low-slope or flat roof, scoped for the building, not guessed from the street. Call {{phone}}. You get a bid a property manager can take to ownership.
highlights: TPO roof systems on commercial flat roofs
Commercial flat roofing for large complexes
Mulehide-certified installer
10-year labor and material warranty on most roofs
Crews large enough to stay on a big TPO roof
Written bid before work starts
heading: When the building needs a TPO roof
body: A TPO roof is a single-ply membrane used on flat and low-slope commercial roofs. If that is the system the building should have, say so when you call. We will confirm it on the roof.

sections.heading: When the building needs a TPO roof
sections.body: Owners and property managers ask for a TPO roof when the building is flat and a shingle roof is the wrong product. We treat TPO as its own service, next to the broader commercial flat roofing page, so the scope matches the system. The words are the same job seen two ways: a flat roof, and a TPO roof when TPO is what goes down.

sections.heading: Crew size on a large TPO roof
sections.body: A handful of people cannot turn a complex. We can put up to 20 workers on a roof and produce thousands of squares a week. That is why the commercial work includes apartment communities and multi-building sites, not only a single storefront. Most crews in this market are 4 or 5 people. They pass on the big TPO roof. We do not.

sections.heading: Certified install, full warranty
sections.body: We are a Mulehide-certified installer. Mulehide is the membrane brand tied to Firestone. The certification is how we offer a 10-year labor and material warranty on most roofs, covering labor and material, not material alone. We do not cut corners. We do it the right way every time.

sections.heading: Request the bid
sections.body: Call {{phone}} and say you need a TPO roof or commercial flat roofing bid. Residential shingle work is still available. It is not the lead offer on this page. Metal roofing is another lower-competition option when the building calls for standing seam instead of a TPO roof.

faq.a: Yes. A TPO roof on commercial flat roofing jobs. Call {{phone}} for a written bid.

moreFaqs.a: TPO is a single-ply membrane used on a flat roof or other low-slope commercial roof. Commercial flat roofing is the general term. A TPO roof is the system when that membrane is specified.

On most roofs we service, the warranty is 10 years on labor and material. We are a Mulehide-certified installer. Mulehide is the Firestone membrane brand. The estimate states what applies to your building.
Yes. Residential is a separate service. This page is for commercial TPO roof and flat roof bids. Call {{phone}} and say which one you need.

title: Metal roofing
shortDesc: Standing-seam metal for buildings that should not take another shingle or flat roof. Fewer crews chase this work.
fullDesc: Metal roofing sits next to commercial flat roofing as a lower-competition specialty. A building that has already had two shingle roofs does not need a third if metal is the better roof. Faber Roof installs standing-seam metal: long panels, raised seams, and a finish that sheds water instead of soaking a tab. A brick building in Metro Detroit carries this system, skylights included. Call {{phone}}. The estimate says yes or no after someone sees the roof.
highlights: Standing-seam panels, not exposed-fastener sheets
Skylights set into the roof when the building has them
A system for buildings that should not take another shingle roof
Written yes or no after the look
Metro Detroit, from the Farmington Hills office
heading: When shingles are the wrong roof
body: You already know the cycle: granules in the gutter, a patch, another replacement. Metal ends that cycle on buildings that can carry it. You should not order it from a photo. You should ask, then get a look.

sections.heading: When shingles are the wrong roof
sections.body: You already know the cycle: granules in the gutter, a patch, another replacement. Metal ends that cycle on buildings that can carry it. You should not order it from a photo. You should ask, then get a look.

sections.heading: Standing seam, including skylights
sections.body: Standing-seam panels run the length of the slope. The seams stand up and lock, so the fasteners are not sitting in the weather the way they do on a screw-down panel. Skylights can stay in the roof. Faber Roof has installed this on a brick building. If your building needs the same kind of roof, that is the conversation to start.

sections.heading: How you find out if it fits
sections.body: Call {{phone}}. Give the address, whether the building is a house or a commercial property, and whether you want metal instead of shingles. Someone looks at the structure and the slopes. You get a written estimate if metal is the right roof, or a straight no if it is not.

sections.heading: Metro Detroit
sections.body: The crew works from Farmington Hills into Detroit and the suburbs between them. Metal is not limited to one township. It is limited to buildings where the system belongs.

faq.a: Yes. Standing-seam metal, including roofs with skylights. Call {{phone}} and ask if it fits your building.

moreFaqs.q: Can you put metal over the old shingles?
moreFaqs.a: We do not. The shingles come off so the deck can be checked. Standing seam goes on a roof we have seen, not on top of a layer that is already tired.

moreFaqs.q: Will a metal roof be loud in the rain?
moreFaqs.a: Standing seam over a solid deck is not the drumming people remember from a barn roof. If noise is the worry, say so when you call. We will tell you what the building will actually sound like.
Often yes. Skylights can be flashed into the panels. If one is already leaking, that gets called out on the estimate instead of being buried.

title: Residential roofing
shortDesc: Your shingles are tired, or the ceiling already has a stain. You get a look at the house and a written estimate before anyone names a price.
fullDesc: Residential roofing stays on the site. It is the secondary path. Commercial flat roofing and TPO roofs are the main work. When the job is a house, water in the ceiling does not stay in the ceiling. It finds the insulation, the drywall, and the next rain. You call {{phone}}. Someone gets on the roof in {{city}} or elsewhere in Metro Detroit, then writes what the house actually needs: a repair, or the old shingles off and a new roof on.
highlights: On-roof look before a price
Repair when the rest of the roof still has life
Tear-off and architectural shingles when it does not
Written estimate you can act on
Houses, lake homes, and attached homes
heading: When the stain shows up in your ceiling
body: A bucket under the drip is not a repair. The stain means water already passed the shingles. Another patch on the same spot usually fails at the next storm. You want the leak found, then a price for the fix that will hold through winter.

sections.heading: When the stain shows up in your ceiling
sections.body: A bucket under the drip is not a repair. The stain means water already passed the shingles. Another patch on the same spot usually fails at the next storm. You want the leak found, then a price for the fix that will hold through winter.

sections.heading: What gets checked on your house
sections.body: Someone looks at the shingles, the flashing at walls and chimneys, the pipe boots, the ridge, and any soft spots in the deck. You hear whether a repair will hold or the roof needs to come off. The estimate names the work. It is not a guess from the street.

sections.heading: Tear-off and new shingles
sections.body: When the roof is done, the old shingles come off, the deck is checked, and new architectural shingles go on. Faber Roof has put gray and charcoal shingles on houses, lake homes, and attached homes across the west side of Metro Detroit. One homeowner had a tear-off and new shingles finished in a day. Another said the cleanup looked like the crew was never there. A one-day finish depends on the size of the roof.

sections.heading: Shingle colors
sections.body: You pick the color when the new shingles go on. Landmark Pro colors include black, gray, brown, and tan. Ask which ones fit the house when you call.

sections.heading: Farmington Hills, Detroit, and the towns between
sections.body: The office is on Haggerty Road in Farmington Hills. You can call from Farmington, Novi, Livonia, Northville, or Detroit. {{phone}} is the estimate line. Say the address and you get a time to look at the roof.

faq.a: Yes. Houses, lake homes, and attached homes. Call {{phone}} with the address and you get a look, then a written estimate.

moreFaqs.q: Can you repair one leak instead of replacing the roof?
moreFaqs.a: Yes, when the leak is in one spot and the rest of the shingles still lie flat. A pipe boot, a chimney, or a skylight is often a repair. If leaks keep moving, replacement is usually the better spend.

moreFaqs.q: What do you look at before you name a price?
moreFaqs.a: Someone gets on the roof. Shingles, flashing, pipe boots, the ridge, and any soft deck. The estimate names repair or tear-off. It is not a number from the street.

moreFaqs.q: Do you work on lake homes?
moreFaqs.a: Yes. Lake lots take more wind. Those roofs are scoped as a full system, not a handful of replaced tabs. Call {{phone}} with the address.

title: Shingle roofing
shortDesc: Missing shingles and a soft deck get worse every rain. You get the old layer off, the deck checked, and architectural shingles named on the estimate.
fullDesc: Curled tabs, missing pieces, and granules in the gutter mean the roof is done protecting the house. You call {{phone}}. The crew strips the old shingles, checks the deck, and installs architectural shingles. Gray and charcoal roofs on brick, stone, and sided houses are the kind of work Faber Roof does across Metro Detroit. CertainTeed Landmark Pro is one shingle to ask about. Your estimate names the product.
highlights: Full tear-off, not a second layer over a tired roof
Deck checked before the new shingles go on
Architectural shingles in gray and charcoal
CertainTeed Landmark Pro when that is the right product
Price in writing after the look
heading: When the shingles stop keeping water out
body: A few new shingles on a worn roof only hide the next leak. Wind gets under the loose tabs. Water reaches the deck. You feel it later as a stain. The useful step is a look at the whole slope, then a decision: repair the spot, or take the roof off.

sections.heading: When the shingles stop keeping water out
sections.body: A few new shingles on a worn roof only hide the next leak. Wind gets under the loose tabs. Water reaches the deck. You feel it later as a stain. The useful step is a look at the whole slope, then a decision: repair the spot, or take the roof off.

sections.heading: What a replacement includes
sections.body: The old shingles come off. The crew checks the deck for soft wood and replaces what will not hold a nail. Underlayment goes down. New architectural shingles, flashing, and ridge detail go on. Bundles are staged on the roof before the install so the job is not waiting on a delivery. One homeowner said the tear-off and new shingles were done the same day. That depends on the size of the house.

sections.heading: The shingle on your estimate
sections.body: Ask about CertainTeed Landmark Pro. It is one of the architectural shingles Faber Roof installs. The written estimate names the product, the color, and the scope so you are not guessing what lands on the house. Call {{phone}}.

sections.heading: Where the shingle roofs are
sections.body: The work is on houses, two-garage homes, lake houses, and attached homes from the Farmington Hills office out toward Detroit. You do not need to live next door to the office. You need an address someone can drive to and look at.

faq.a: Architectural shingles. CertainTeed Landmark Pro is one to ask about. Your estimate names the product and color. Call {{phone}}.

moreFaqs.q: How many layers of shingles will you tear off?
moreFaqs.a: Whatever is on the roof. One layer comes off. Two layers come off. We do not add a third. You hear the layer count after someone is up there.

moreFaqs.q: Do you replace the deck if it is soft?
moreFaqs.a: Yes. Soft plywood is replaced before the new shingles go down. Spots we can see are on the estimate. Anything else that shows up at tear-off is called out before it is covered.
You do. The estimate names the product and the color before the shingles are ordered, so the roof is not a surprise when the crew arrives.
